statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete across the single-page speed-test tool and its details/settings interaction surface.

page.notes: Single-page public speed-test utility. Homepage, live measurement, responsive/preference conditions, and authored settings/help surfaces represent all distinct archetypes. Localized routes share the same template and were not duplicated; external privacy/blog pages are out of scope.

paths.description: Homepage and automatically running/completed speed measurement; the site is genuinely a single-page utility.
Show-more/details, settings fields and help/disclosure surface; represents the only secondary interactive archetype.

findings.summary: The interface is hard-coded to a light theme.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is visually identical to the light capture, and the DOM CSS sets html/body background-color:white with no dark media rule or color-scheme declaration.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and retint surfaces, text, controls and theme-color with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: The loading spinner keeps rotating when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the evaluate probe still found uil-ring-anim running infinitely with a 1000 ms duration.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable the non-essential rotation in a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce media query and retain a static progress state.

findings.summary: Details, settings and help swap abruptly through display changes.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS shows hidden panels toggled with display:none/block and no view-transition-name or document.startViewTransition use.
findings.suggestedFix: Use progressive same-document View Transitions or a reduced-motion-aware entry/exit transition when panels open and close.

findings.summary: The language menu is a manually positioned custom overlay.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS shows .dropdown-content position:absolute; right:0 with no popover, anchor-name, position-anchor or position-try fallback.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a popover anchored to the language button and CSS anchor positioning with fallback positions.

findings.summary: Dropdown, settings and help disclosures use generic divs and manual visibility toggles.
findings.evidence: The document probe found zero dialog/popover elements and three custom overlay/disclosure containers.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover for the language menu and details/dialog semantics for disclosure and settings, preserving light-dismiss and keyboard behavior.

findings.summary: The page omits the viewport meta tag, so mobile browsers render a 980 CSS-pixel desktop viewport and scale it down.
findings.evidence: At a requested 360x800 viewport, layout reported innerWidth/clientWidth 980 and hasViewportMeta:false; the mobile screenshot shows small scaled header controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and re-test the portrait layout without disabling zoom.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is tied only to viewport orientation and global media rules.
findings.evidence: The captured CSS uses @media (orientation: portrait) and vh/vw sizing but contains no container-type or @container rules for reused controls/panels.
findings.suggestedFix: Make reusable result and settings components size-aware with container queries where they can appear in constrained containers.

findings.summary: Visible controls are too small on mobile and custom controls lack a visible focus treatment.
findings.evidence: The 360px capture is a scaled 980px layout; focus probes report outline:none on Show more info, Settings, Save, Cancel and all settings inputs.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 44x44 CSS-pixel touch targets and a high-contrast :focus-visible style for every actionable control.

findings.summary: Mobile Lighthouse observed substantial main-thread blocking.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 640 ms Total Blocking Time (score 0.46), although the unthrottled CDP trace saw no long tasks; the throttled mobile result establishes a risk on slower devices.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the startup and speed-test loop under mobile throttling, then split or schedule long work and avoid tight synchronous measurement/update loops.

findings.summary: Several icon links and numeric settings fields lack accessible names or associated labels.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse identifies Help, Facebook and Twitter links without discernible names; the document probe finds no labels for min/max connection and duration inputs.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every icon control an accessible name and associate explicit labels with each numeric input.

findings.summary: The page has no heading structure and key custom controls suppress focus outlines.
findings.evidence: The document probe found zero h1/h2/h3 elements and outline:none on the main disclosure, settings controls and inputs.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a logical h1/section heading structure and consistent :focus-visible styling; manage focus when disclosures open and close.

findings.evidence: The headers primitive confirms HTTPS and HSTS but no Content-Security-Policy and no X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP (including frame-ancestors) and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, testing in report-only mode first.

findings.summary: Clickjacking, referrer and permissions defenses are not declared.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors, a strict Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy alongside the CSP rollout.

findings.summary: The document language is not exposed on the root element and layout CSS relies heavily on physical directions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails html-has-lang; the probe reports html.lang empty while body uses a nonstandard language="en" attribute. Captured CSS uses left/right margins, floats and positioning rather than logical properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang on <html>, set dir for RTL locales, and migrate directional layout to logical properties with locale tests.

findings.summary: Settings number fields provide bounds but no associated guidance or accessible validation surface.
findings.evidence: The settings DOM exposes min/max numeric inputs without labels, aria-describedby or a visible/announced validation message container.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate field labels and hints, validate after interaction, and announce actionable range errors through an aria-live or linked error message.

findings.summary: The page is crawlable but not correctly configured for mobile rendering.
findings.evidence: robots.txt allows crawling and links use hrefs, but the DOM has no viewport meta and a requested 360px viewport renders at 980 CSS pixels.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a scalable width=device-width viewport declaration while preserving the existing crawlable links and robots policy.

taskList.title: Restore real mobile layout, scalable viewport, touch targets and focus visibility
Add accessible names, labels, headings and humane field errors
Deploy CSP and defensive response headers
Reduce mobile main-thread blocking in the startup/test loop
Replace custom disclosure/overlay plumbing with semantic modern primitives
Adopt container-aware component sizing and root-language/logical CSS hygiene
